acip: ZHES GSUNGS PA LTAR THABS DANG SHES RAB DBYER MED PAR SBYOR BA'I RDO RJE SEMS DPA'I RNAL 'BYOR NI RDO RJE STE THEG PA YANG DE'O, ,DE LA 'DIS 'GRO BA RGYU'I THEG PA DANG 'DIR 'GRO BA 'BRAS BU'I THEG PA GNYIS SO, ,THEG PA DES 'GRO BA'I SNGAGS KYI SDOM LDAN RNAMS LA BCAS PA'I BCAS PA DANG 'GAL BA'I LAS KYI SGRIB PA NI GNAS 'OG MAR 'KHRID PA DANG , YON TAN GONG MA SKYE BA LA SGRIB PAS NA LTUNG BA YIN LA,
wylie: zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs dang shes rab dbyer med par sbyor ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor ni rdo rje ste theg pa yang de'o, ,de la 'dis 'gro ba rgyu'i theg pa dang 'dir 'gro ba 'bras bu'i theg pa gnyis so, ,theg pa des 'gro ba'i sngags kyi sdom ldan rnams la bcas pa'i bcas pa dang 'gal ba'i las kyi sgrib pa ni gnas 'og mar 'khrid pa dang , yon tan gong ma skye ba la sgrib pas na ltung ba yin la
english: What Shantipa is describing here is that the yoga of the Warrior of Diamond is where we yoke together, indivisibly, method and wisdom.  This then is both the diamond and the way. This diamond way is both a way which is a cause--that is, a way by which we make our spiritual journey; and a way which is a result--the place to which we are journeying. Now when those who are traveling upon this way--that is, those who possess the vows of the secret word--act against the rules that have been set down for them, then this creates a karmic obstacle.  This obstacle leads them to a lower place, and obstructs them from developing higher spiritual qualities.  As such, it is called a "downfall."
